title: On Trump’s Ballroom, Chief Justice Finds Himself in an Unusual Spot: In Dissent
summary: Chief Justice John G. Roberts Jr. has been in the majority in divided cases more times than any other chief since 1953. But not this time.
body_markdown: Chief Justice John G. Roberts Jr. has been in the majority in divided cases more times than any other chief since 1953. But not this time.
